task_description: Build SpartanCircle - a mobile-first web app helping SJSU freshmen and transfer students find compatible friends, study buddies, project partners, study pods, and campus events. Complete production-quality MVP with Next.js, Supabase setup, deterministic matching, real-time chat, PWA support, and demo-ready flow.

verification.summary: pnpm build succeeds with 21 routes (16 static + 5 dynamic). All 52 unit tests pass covering matching score calculation, availability overlap, pod generation, event recommendation, and access control filters. Tests exercise real algorithm logic with various inputs and verify correct scoring behavior.
